[P3] 香蕉娃娃
文/姚媛 图/胡永凯

[P4] 很久很久以前，有一位驼背老爷爷，一个人孤独地生活着。老爷爷种着一大片香蕉林，他喜欢看着香蕉树慢慢长大，简直把它们当作了自己的孩子。每天看着一串串香蕉在风中轻轻摇动，老爷爷总是忍不住要笑出声来。

[P5] 可是天有不测风云，在一个非常非常寒冷的冬天，香蕉树都被冻死了。老爷爷伤心极了，他呆呆地坐在香蕉林边上，那里已经没有香蕉了，只剩下一片茫茫大雪。

[P6] 冬去春来，老爷爷每天都到香蕉林里去守望。结果有一天，奇迹发生了，在一棵已经冻死的香蕉树上居然冒出了一个小嫩芽。老爷爷高兴得手舞足蹈，他细心地浇水，施肥，捉虫，耐心等待小嫩芽长大，就像对待自己的孩子一样。日子一天天过去，小嫩芽长成了一根水桶那么粗的大香蕉。

[P7] 老爷爷天天守着自己的宝贝大香蕉，把自己所有的爱都给了它，简直一刻都舍不得离开。可有一天他正打盹的时候，一只孔雀飞到香蕉树旁边，“咚”地在大香蕉上使劲啄了一口。这下老爷爷差点急疯了，他顾不上孔雀，赶紧去看自己的宝贝香蕉。没想到香蕉皮居然裂开了，从里面蹦出来一个白白嫩嫩的大胖小子，脆生生地对着老爷爷叫了一声：“爹！”，

[P8] 老爷爷这个高兴哟，简直
忘了自己姓甚名谁。他给大胖
小子起了一个名字，就叫香蕉
娃娃。打这以后，父子俩一块
种起了香蕉，老爷爷再也不是
一个人了。

[P9] 日子流水一样过去，香蕉娃娃越长越大，可老爷爷的背，却越来越驼，越来越难受。看着父亲常常疼得“哎呦”、“哎呦”直叫唤，香蕉娃娃心疼得不行。于是有一天，他辞别了父亲，下定决心要找到一种能治好背疼的药。

[P10] 香蕉娃娃走啊走，走啊走，走了七七四十九天，来到了一座大青山，见到了一位穿着五彩霞衣的仙女。仙女告诉他：“东山的岩洞里有一颗珍珠，可以治好驼背。”香蕉娃娃谢过仙女姐姐，走啊走，又走了七七四十九天，爬上陡峭的东山，摸进岩洞，终于采到了珍珠。

[P11] 香蕉娃娃高兴极了，心里想着赶快回家给爸爸治病。可是在回家的路上，他却遇到了一个放牛娃，正坐在山坡上哇哇大哭。原来，刚才两头牛打架，放牛娃去劝架的时候，不小心弄伤了手。

[P12] 珍珠倒是可以治好放牛娃的手，可那是给爸爸治疗驼背的呀。香蕉娃娃想了半天，还是把珍珠给放牛娃吃了。“给爸爸治病的药，我再去找吧。”看着放牛娃又活蹦乱跳了，香蕉娃娃的心情也好了起来。

[P13] 香蕉娃娃走了七七四十九天，回到了大青山，再去找穿着五彩霞衣的仙女。仙女对他说：“西山顶上的灵芝，也能治好驼背。”香蕉娃娃谢过仙女姐姐，走啊走，又走了七七四十九天，爬上西山峰顶，摘下灵芝。

[P14] 香蕉娃娃高兴极了，心里
想着赶快回家给爸爸治病。结果这次回家的路上，他又遇上
了一位老爷爷，他被一棵吹倒
的大树压断了腿，正躺在地上
痛苦地呻吟呢。

[P15] 灵芝倒是可以治好老爷爷的腿，可那是给爸爸治疗驼背的呀。香蕉娃娃想了半天，还是把灵芝给老爷爷吃了。给爸爸治病的药，我再去找吧。看着老爷爷又能站起来走路了，香蕉娃娃的心情也轻松了起来。

[P16] 香蕉娃娃走了七七四十九天，回到了大青山，再去找穿着五彩霞衣的仙女。仙女看着香蕉娃娃，对他说：“香蕉娃娃，这是最后一次了，我只知道，还剩下南山水潭里的金色宝石能治好驼背了。”香蕉娃娃谢过仙女姐姐，又走了七七四十九天，爬上南山，潜进水潭里，拿到了金色宝石。

[P17] 香蕉娃娃高兴极了，心里想着赶快回家给爸爸治病。他想，这回的金色宝石可千万不能再给别人了。结果在回家的路上，他却遇到一个摔得头破血流的大婶，旁边还有一个哭得稀里哗啦的小娃娃。

[P18] 金色宝石倒是可以治好大婶的头，可那是给爸爸治疗驼背的呀，而且这是最后一次机会了。香蕉娃娃想啊想，想了半天，最后还是把金色宝石给了大婶。可是给爸爸治病的药，再去哪里找呢，香蕉娃娃的心情有点沉重。

[P19] 不一会儿的功夫，大婶醒过来了。她笑着对香蕉娃娃说：“香蕉娃娃，你的心肠真好，这只孔雀，送给你，谢谢你救了我。”说完，抱起孩子，一转身上了桥。奇怪的是，转眼功夫就不见了她的踪影。

[P20] 这回没有东西能治爸爸的驼背了。香蕉娃娃难过极了，他抱着孔雀，垂头丧气地回到了家，一五一十地把经过告诉了爸爸。老爷爷听了他的故事，心疼地说：“没有药没关系，下次可别再去爬东山西峰了，多危险啊。”

[P21] 日子一天天过去。有一天，
老爷爷的背实在疼得厉害，香蕉
娃娃连忙使劲帮爸爸捶背。这时候，
一旁的孔雀却突然变成了一个
美丽的小姑娘。

[P22] 小姑娘微笑着说：“香蕉娃娃，我能治好老爷爷的驼背。”她从小溪里盛来一碗水，端着让老爷爷喝下去。说来也奇怪，没一会儿的功夫，老爷爷背也不驼了，眼也不花了，就连头发，都变黑了。

[P23] 老爷爷、香蕉娃娃和小姑娘，幸福地生活在一起，他们身边，是一片美丽的香蕉林。

[P24] 毛毛虫童书馆·第一辑

[P3] Banana Doll
Text / Yao Yuan  Illustrations / Hu Yongkai

[P4] Long, long ago, there was an old man with a hunched back, living alone. The old man grew a large banana grove. He loved watching the banana trees grow slowly, and he truly regarded them as his own children. Every day, as he watched bunches of bananas gently swaying in the wind, the old man couldn't help but laugh out loud.

[P5] But fate is unpredictable. In a very, very cold winter, all the banana trees were frozen to death. The old man was heartbroken. He sat dazedly by the edge of the banana grove, where there were no bananas left, only a vast expanse of snow.

[P6] As winter passed and spring arrived, the old man went to the banana grove every day to watch over it. One day, a miracle happened: a tiny sprout emerged from a banana tree that had frozen to death. The old man was overjoyed, dancing with delight. He carefully watered, fertilized, and protected it from pests, patiently waiting for the sprout to grow, just as he would care for his own child. Day by day, the sprout grew into a huge banana as thick as a water bucket.

[P7] The old man guarded his precious big banana every day, giving it all his love and not wanting to leave for even a moment. But one day, while he was dozing off, a peacock flew to the banana tree and “thunk” gave the big banana a hard peck. The old man nearly went crazy with worry. He didn’t even care about the peacock and rushed to check on his precious banana. To his surprise, the banana peel split open, and a plump, white baby boy popped out, calling out to the old man in a clear, bright voice: “Dad!”,

[P8] The old man was so happy, he almost forgot his own name. He gave the chubby little boy a name: Banana Baby. From then on, father and son planted bananas together, and the old man was no longer alone.

[P9] Days passed like flowing water. The banana baby grew bigger and bigger, but the old man's back became more and more hunched and painful. Seeing his father often cry out in pain, "Aiyo, aiyo," the banana baby felt heartbroken. So one day, he bid farewell to his father and made up his mind to find a medicine that could cure his back pain.

[P10] The banana baby walked and walked, walked and walked, for seventy-seven days and forty-nine days, until he reached a big green mountain, where he met a fairy wearing a colorful rainbow robe. The fairy told him: "There is a pearl in the cave on the eastern mountain that can cure a hunched back." The banana baby thanked the fairy sister, walked and walked, and after another seventy-seven days and forty-nine days, climbed the steep eastern mountain, entered the cave, and finally found the pearl.

[P11] The banana baby was overjoyed, thinking about hurrying home to cure his father's illness. But on his way home, he met a cowherd boy sitting on the hillside, crying loudly. It turned out that just now, two bulls were fighting, and the cowherd boy got hurt while trying to break them up.

[P12] The pearl could heal the cowherd boy's hand, but it was meant to cure Dad's hunchback. The Banana Baby thought for a while, then gave the pearl to the cowherd boy to eat. "The medicine to cure Dad, I'll go find it again." Seeing the cowherd boy jump around happily again, the Banana Baby's mood brightened up.

[P13] The banana baby walked for forty-nine days, returned to Mount Daqing, and went to find the fairy wearing a colorful rainbow robe. The fairy told him, "The lingzhi on the top of the western mountain can also cure hunchback." The banana baby thanked the fairy sister, walked on, walked for another forty-nine days, climbed to the peak of the western mountain, and picked the lingzhi.

[P14] The banana baby was overjoyed, thinking about hurrying home to cure his father's illness. But on his way back, he met an old man who had been crushed by a fallen tree, his leg broken, lying on the ground in agony.

[P15] The lingzhi could heal the old man's leg, but it was meant for Dad's hunched back. The Banana Baby thought for a while, then gave the lingzhi to the old man. I'll find the medicine for Dad again. Seeing the old man able to stand and walk again, the Banana Baby felt much lighter in heart.

[P16] The banana baby walked for seventy-seven days and forty-nine days, returned to Mount Daqing, and went to find the fairy wearing a colorful rainbow robe. The fairy looked at the banana baby and said to him, "Banana baby, this is the last time. I only know that the golden gem in the pond on the southern mountain can cure hunchback." The banana baby thanked the fairy sister, walked for another seventy-seven days and forty-nine days, climbed Mount Nan, dived into the pond, and got the golden gem.

[P17] The banana doll was overjoyed, thinking about hurrying home to cure his father. He thought, this time the golden gem must not be given to anyone else. But on his way home, he met a woman who had fallen and was bleeding from her head, with a little child crying beside her.

[P18] The golden gem could heal Auntie's head, but it was meant to cure Dad's hunchback, and this was the last chance. Banana Baby thought and thought, pondered for a while, and finally gave the golden gem to Auntie. But where could he find medicine to cure Dad now? Banana Baby felt a bit heavy-hearted.

[P19] In no time, the woman woke up. She smiled at Banana Baby and said, "Banana Baby, you have such a kind heart. This peacock is for you, thank you for saving me." Then she picked up her child, turned, and walked onto the bridge. Strangely, in the blink of an eye, she was gone.

[P20] There was nothing this time that could cure Dad's hunched back. The Banana Baby was heartbroken. He held the peacock and returned home dejectedly, telling his father every detail of what had happened. Grandpa listened to his story and said with concern, "It's okay not to have medicine. Just don't go climbing the peaks of Dongshan and Xishan again—how dangerous that is!"

[P21] Days passed one after another. One day,
Grandpa's back hurt terribly, and Banana
Baby hurried to help his father massage his back. At that moment,
the peacock beside him suddenly turned into a
beautiful little girl.

[P22] The little girl smiled and said, "Banana Baby, I can cure Grandpa's hunched back." She fetched a bowl of water from a small stream and held it for Grandpa to drink. Strange as it may seem, in no time at all, Grandpa's back was no longer hunched, his eyes no longer blurry, and even his hair turned black.

[P23] Grandpa, Banana Baby, and the little girl live happily together. Around them is a beautiful banana grove.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《香蕉娃娃》的封面，画面中一个扎着双马尾的小女孩依偎在绿色的香蕉形状物体上，背景为橙黄色。封面上标注了作者姚暖、绘者胡永凯，以及出版社新蕾出版社和系列名毛毛虫童书馆。
[P2] 本页为绘本《香蕉娃娃》的版权信息页，列出了出版发行单位、联系方式、地址、印刷信息、开本、印张、版次及定价等出版细节。
[P3] 本页为绘本《香蕉娃娃》的书名页，显示了书名、作者姚媛和绘者胡永凯的名字，下方配有红、蓝、绿三色波浪形装饰图案。
[P4] 本页讲述了很久以前，一位驼背老爷爷独自生活，他种着一大片香蕉林，并把香蕉树当作自己的孩子，每天看着香蕉摇动时都会开心地笑出来。
[P5] 在一个寒冷的冬天，香蕉树被冻死，老爷爷伤心地坐在雪中的香蕉林边。
[P6] 冬去春来，老爷爷在冻死的香蕉树上发现了一株小嫩芽，他精心照料，最终嫩芽长成了一根巨大的香蕉。
[P7] 老爷爷守护着他的大香蕉，一只孔雀啄了香蕉一口，结果香蕉裂开，一个白白嫩嫩的胖娃娃从里面蹦出来，叫老爷爷“爹”。
[P8] 老爷爷为从香蕉里出生的娃娃取名为‘香蕉娃娃’，从此父子俩一起种香蕉，老爷爷不再孤单。
[P9] 香蕉娃娃看着老爷爷因背疼而痛苦，决定离家寻找能治好背疼的药。
[P10] 香蕉娃娃在寻找治驼背药的过程中，遇到一位仙女，得知东山岩洞里有能治驼背的珍珠，他历经艰辛终于采到了珍珠。
[P11] 香蕉娃娃在回家途中遇到一个因劝架而受伤的放牛娃，两头牛正在山坡上打架。
[P12] 香蕉娃娃在回家途中遇到受伤的放牛娃，他本想用珍珠治爸爸的驼背，但最终选择把珍珠给了放牛娃治手，自己决定再去找药，看到放牛娃康复后心情变好。
[P13] 香蕉娃娃回到大青山，向仙女询问治驼背的药，仙女告诉他西山顶上的灵芝可以治病，他于是再次出发，历经艰辛爬上西山峰顶摘下灵芝。
[P14] 香蕉娃娃在回家途中遇到一位被倒下的大树压断腿的老爷爷，老爷爷正痛苦地呻吟。
[P15] 香蕉娃娃在回家途中遇到一位被大树压断腿的老爷爷，他本想用灵芝治爸爸的驼背，但最终选择把灵芝给了老爷爷治腿，自己决定再去找药，看到老爷爷康复后心情变好。
[P16] 香蕉娃娃第三次向仙女求助，得知南山水潭中的金色宝石能治好驼背，他历经艰辛潜入水潭，终于拿到了宝石。
[P17] 香蕉娃娃带着从南山水潭中找到的金色宝石回家，途中遇到一位摔伤头破血流的大婶和她哭泣的孩子。
[P18] 香蕉娃娃在回家途中遇到一位摔伤头破血流的大婶和她哭泣的孩子，他本想用金色宝石治爸爸的驼背，但最终选择把宝石给了大婶治伤，自己则为找不到新药而心情沉重。
[P19] 大婶醒来后感谢香蕉娃娃救了她，并送给他一只孔雀作为礼物，随后便消失不见。
[P20] 香蕉娃娃带着孔雀回到家，向爸爸讲述了自己未能找到治驼背的药的经历，爸爸心疼地劝他不要再冒险爬山。
[P21] 香蕉娃娃正在为爸爸捶背，一旁的孔雀突然变成了一位美丽的姑娘。
[P22] 小姑娘用溪水治好了老爷爷的驼背，老爷爷的背、眼睛和头发都恢复了健康。
[P23] 老爷爷、香蕉娃娃和小姑娘幸福地生活在一起，周围是一片美丽的香蕉林。
[P24] 本页为《毛毛虫童书馆·第一辑》的目录页，列出了该辑包含的七本绘本名称，并标注了策划、责编、装帧指导和设计人员信息。右侧配有一幅孔雀与香蕉结合的插图。
